method: From 2026-10-12 all positions are computed with calibration/geometry_v2.json (camera offsets from the HoveringAUV socket figures) from the same image sources as before. A_pipe_front_2: segment from crack end points traced on ticks 463 ((240,289)-(383,252)) and 478 ((327,291)-(466,254)) of capture_test_mixed_20261008_190916_184618, end points averaged over the two views, radius 0.35 m. revisions: 2026-10-08: A_pier_0_1 changed from a point (-10.0, -5.55, -8.4) r 0.6 m to a segment. The P1 baseline counted a PatchCore alert at tick 3478 as false although its box lies on the visible crack (0.71 m from the old point); the segment follows the crack seen in the image, not the detector output.

Positions move by up to 0.3 m (pier) and onto the smaller fitted pipe radius.
